text_block_list.text:
The fan votes have been tallied, and
Grass
Wonder has earned a slot in the
Arima Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The showdown with Марузенски is at
hand, and
Grass Wonder can barely
contain her excitement.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, Марузенски suffers an
injury while
training and is forced to
withdraw from the race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
What's more, Грасс Вандер learns that

Марузенски had intended the Arima
Kinen to be
her last race in the Twinkle
Series.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
